technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with multiple oscillator confirmations and exceptional volume spike, but lack of trend strength (ADX 19.2), long-term MA resistance, and overbought conditions limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: SWK shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 2 days present elevated volatility risk with weak fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 36.7% vs bullish 28.4%) with greed reading (61) suggests neutral positioning; insufficient news data to confirm directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 181 crisis regime, FOMC in 1 day) combined with earnings binary event in 2 days creates compounded tail risk unsuitable for directional positioning.

debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional 15x volume spike combined with six aligned oscillator confirmations (StochRSI, MACD, OBV, Force Index) and price near support (73.83) create a textbook short-term momentum entry with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary in 2 days + FOMC in 1 day + VIX crisis regime (181) + price below all major moving averages + ADX weakness (19.2) + Williams %R overbought exhaustion create compounded tail risk that overwhelms technical setup.
